races.race_name: Ladbrokes "Bet £5 Get £30 New Customer Offer" EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Next Of Kin
runners.spotlight: Out of a Group-placed 6f/7f 2yo winner and kept on well for third on recent debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm), despite showing her inexperience; improvement likely here; leading contender.
runners.comment: Kept on for third on debut at Newbury, despite showing her inexperience; big player

runners.name: Desert Smoke
runners.spotlight: Disappointing favourite when only fifth of six at York last month but her debut at Newmarket (also 6f, good to firm) a fortnight earlier was promising and she remains one to be interested in.
runners.comment: Disappointing favourite on second start but her debut run was promising

runners.name: Fly Smartly
runners.spotlight: Out of a well-connected 7f 2yo winner and displayed clear promise on first two starts, more recently when fifth at Curragh (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; drops back in trip here; ought to make her presence felt.
runners.comment: Irish raider who displayed clear promise on both starts (5f/7f); can make presence felt

runners.name: La Flor Granada
runners.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; eighth foal; half-sister to winners Baba Boom (11.3f-12.3f; RPR 92) and New York Dreams (US 6.5f turf); dam unraced half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner The Tin Man and 6f Group 2 winner Deacon Blues; good market support will bring her into the equation.
runners.comment: Out of unraced half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner The Tin Man; market may guide on debut

runners.name: Myesme
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to 6f winner Thelma's Angel (RPR 88); dam Listed-placed 5f/5.4f winner (109), closely related to 5f/6f winner Daffy Jane, half-sister to 7f Group 3 winner Last Empire; makes appeal on paper.
runners.comment: Out of a Listed-placed 5f/5.4f winner; makes appeal on paper

runners.name: Lady Titania
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to Nunthorpe winner Reverence; weakened into seventh in York novice (6f, good to firm) last month but represents a good stable and can improve if aided by new tongue-tie here.
runners.comment: Weakened into seventh on debut at York but represents a good stable; can probably improve

runners.name: Dadawada
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to two Group-winning sprinters and a Listed sprint winner but made a low-key debut for Gemma Tutty at Musselburgh (5f, good) in June; now with new stable.
runners.comment: Out of a well-connected mare but made a low-key debut in June; now with new stable

runners.name: Ashina
runners.spotlight: Raced too freely and ran green when last of six in valuable Doncaster maiden (6.5f, good to firm) on debut in June; ought to be more streetwise here but needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Raced too freely and ran green when last of six in valuable Doncaster maiden on debut

runners.name: Oh So Slow Sloth
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to useful 6f/7f performer Brighton Boy; dropped out tamely and finished last of six on debut at Hamilton (6f, good) 12 weeks ago; returns with hood added.
runners.comment: Dropped out tamely and finished last of six on debut at Hamilton (6f) 12 weeks ago

races.race_name: "Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder" Classified Stakes

runners.name: Hostelry
runners.spotlight: Ten-time winner; on the downgrade now but fairly consistent in handicaps in recent months; went without her usual cheekpieces on last two outings; big player in this grade if first-time visor has any positive effect.
runners.comment: Quite consistent in handicaps in recent months; big player in this grade; first-time visor

runners.name: Concert Boy
runners.spotlight: Five-time AW winner but 0-24 on turf; will appreciate this ease in grade but has been out of form since returning from a break in June; needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: Eased in grade today but has been out of form since returning from a break in June
runners.owner: Making Headway Racing And K Scott

runners.name: Bridgefoot Rambler
runners.spotlight: Placed for first time in five-race career when 150-1 third in this grade at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) last month, seemingly aided by first-time blinkers; contender if in similar form again.
runners.comment: Seemingly aided by new blinkers when placed at huge odds last month, her fifth start

runners.name: Millbuie
runners.spotlight: Beaten only by a short head and a nose when third in similar C&D race to this last month and also ran well when second at Newcastle (1m, AW) ten days ago, but his 0-29 strike-rate is not easily overlooked.
runners.comment: Placed three times in this grade (once over C&D) this year, but strike-rate is 0-29
runners.owner: N J Dalgarno & W R Ellis

runners.name: Spirit Of Nature
runners.spotlight: Did not get competitive over C&D on seasonal/handicap debut a fortnight ago, but remains unexposed after only four runs and is worth a glance in the betting.
runners.comment: Well held over C&D on seasonal/handicap debut but remains unexposed

runners.name: Due Respect
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in 7f Musselburgh handicap in June but has not been firing on all cylinders this year and is not yet proven over 1m.
runners.comment: Made the frame in 7f handicap in June, but not at best this year and not proven over 1m

runners.name: Charcon
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced when fifth of 13 in this grade at Newcastle (7f, AW; first-time cheekpieces) last month, but has now been unplaced all eight starts; back up in trip for turf return; improvement required.
runners.comment: Not disgraced in this grade on AW last month but now 0-8; improvement required

runners.name: Hawksworth
runners.spotlight: Showed no significant promise in three novice races in June (7f-1m2f) but has a more realistic chance to get competitive in this basement-grade contest.
runners.comment: Showed no significant promise in three novice races but has more realistic chance here

runners.name: Royal Baroness
runners.spotlight: Stayed on for fourth off basement mark on seasonal/handicap debut at Carlisle (1m, soft) in May, but her well-held third at Musselburgh (1m, good) the following month was a backward step; others look stronger.
runners.comment: Five-race maiden; remote when third in Musselburgh handicap last time; more needed

runners.name: Ring Of Gold
runners.spotlight: Won two 7f AW handicaps in September, but recent turf form has been disappointing and he's now 0-25 on this surface.
runners.comment: Won two 7f AW handicaps in September but recent turf form has been disappointing

runners.name: Sanny Doo
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all nine starts, most recently when tailed off in this grade here (1m2f, good) on Saturday; drops back in trip with cheekpieces refitted.
runners.comment: Tailed off in this grade here (1m2f) on Saturday; cheekpieces refitted

runners.name: Game Management
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on all three Flat starts last year (albeit on ground slower than good) and pulled up twice over hurdles afterwards; returns from 314-day absence with a lot to prove.
runners.comment: Out of form on Flat/over hurdles last year; returns from 314-day absence
runners.owner: Mrs C Clark D Pollitt & Mrs E Quinlan

races.race_name: Ladbrokes "Big Daily Boosts On Racing" Handicap

runners.name: Novak
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won on turf for more than three years but he's run plenty of good races this season including when runner-up over C&D (good to firm) in May and close third at Hamilton (6f, good to soft) in June; hasn't made an impact in last two runs but this drop back in trip is a positive and he's in the mix.
runners.comment: Generally consistent sort who is on a dangerous mark and he's in the mix back in trip

runners.name: Albeyours
runners.spotlight: Two wins since cheekpieces were added last autumn and her last success was at Carlisle (7f, soft) in June; didn't shine at Doncaster (good to firm) last time but that was over 1m and she still looks on a workable mark; dangerous back in trip.
runners.comment: Won over 7f at Carlisle (soft) on his penultimate run and has claims back in trip

runners.name: Kelpie Grey
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner but his last success was in May 2024 and he's not finished closer than fifth in his seven runs this season; needs to find more back up in trip.
runners.comment: His last win was in May 2024 and he disappointed over 6f here on Saturday

runners.name: Catton Lady
runners.spotlight: Ended a long losing run when scoring off 2lb lower at Carlisle (1m, soft) last June; has had just two runs this season but she's run creditably in a handicap and a seller at Beverley; now drops back in trip but has possibilities if she gets a good pace and some luck.
runners.comment: Only 2lb higher than for her last win and has claims if she gets the breaks
runners.owner: W H & Mrs J A Tinning & Mrs C Wallis

runners.name: Black Rock Beauty
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough with cheekpieces added at Redcar (7f, good) in May and he backed that up with a close third of 15 at Doncaster; struggled at Chester last time but that was from a wide draw and he ran into a handicap blot who won by 8l; has possibilities if he can bounce back and he's still unexposed at this trip.
runners.comment: Won at Redcar in May and he had a tough task from wide at Chester latest; not ruled out

runners.name: Yaaser
runners.spotlight: Four-time course winner (7f/1m) who acts on good to firm and good to soft; did well to finish a close third after missing the break at Hamilton (8.3f) nine days ago but he's not easy to predict and was always behind over C&D on Saturday night; risks attached.
runners.comment: Four-time course winner but he was always behind over C&D on Saturday night

runners.name: Carmel Valley
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish filly who has finished close up in handicaps here in her last two starts; gave it a good shot from the front over C&D two weeks ago and she's still unexposed after only six runs; respected off 1lb lower than last time.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly who has finished close up in handicaps here in last two runs; shortlisted

runners.name: Keep Me Stable
runners.spotlight: Three wins at Musselburgh last summer and she returned to form with a creditable second behind her stablemate there (7f, good) on Friday; this is a deeper race but her last win was off a higher mark and she has won at Ayr in the past; respected.
runners.comment: Seven-time winner who returned to form when runner-up at Musselburgh on Friday; respected

runners.name: Joshuas Dream
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has been beaten 15l in two handicaps here (6f, good/good to firm) this season; mark is tumbling but he has a lot to prove with cheekpieces added at this new trip; one of three runners for the yard.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden who has been beaten 15l in two handicaps here this season; passed over

runners.name: Pal Joey
runners.spotlight: Started this year with a 5f win at Newcastle (Tapeta) but he's been disappointing since and was beaten 7l at Newcastle (1m) last month; has plenty to prove and he needs a major revival back in trip; tongue-tie reapplied.
runners.comment: Started this year with a 5f win but he's been disappointing since and has plenty to prove

runners.name: Stoneywell
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has form figures of 89778 in handicaps and was laboured at Redcar (7f, good) when last seen in June; mark continues to fall but he needs a transformation after a short break.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden who has form figures of 89778 in handicaps; opposable

runners.name: Tropez Power
runners.spotlight: His last win was at Southwell in April 2024 but he travelled strongly for a long way before weakening there (7f) last month; record of 1-35 on turf but he's on a much lower mark back in this sphere and is well handicapped on his best form last season; one to keep an eye on with visor reapplied.
runners.comment: Just 1-35 on turf but he's very well treated on his best form last season; not ruled out

runners.name: Gressington
runners.spotlight: His last turf win was in September 2024 and he's finished down the field in most of his runs this season including a laboured after a slow start at Catterick last time; continues to drop down the weights but others are preferred.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark but he's been quiet this season and others are preferred
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner

races.race_name: Ladbrokes "Get More With Ladbucks" Handicap (GBBplus Race)

runners.name: Star Cast
runners.spotlight: Enjoying a fine year and garnered a sixth success in ten-runner handicap over C&D in June; freshened up since and remains handily weighted despite a 5lb rise; big shout.
runners.comment: Notched sixth win of 2026 over C&D in June; remains handily weighted and big shout

runners.name: Spirit Of Acklam
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways in 1m5f handicap at Hamilton last month; this C&D scorer needs considering in refitted cheekpieces (won in them here) nudged up 1lb.
runners.comment: Resumed winning ways at Hamilton; this C&D scorer needs considering nudged up 1lb

runners.name: Pearl Eye
runners.spotlight: Already a dual winner for current yard, going in over C&D in July; posted another solid effort with fourth of five over C&D last time; can't be discounted.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D in July; solid effort with fourth over C&D last time; can't be discounted

runners.name: Obito
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last summer; back in good form of late and posted a solid fifth of eight in 1m2f Doncaster handicap last month; in the mix once more.
runners.comment: C&D winner last summer; back in good form of late so he's in the mix once more

runners.name: Lorca's Waltz
runners.spotlight: Lope De Vega gelding who resumed from five months off to land 7.5f maiden at Beverley in June; suffered a poor run on his handicap debut when fourth of five at Sandown (1m) 17 days ago and remains capable of better; likely player.
runners.comment: Suffered poor run on handicap debut when fourth at Sandown; remains capable of better
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: Ziata
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden for Ed Walker; made a winning start for new yard in five-runner maiden at Windsor (1m2f) two weeks ago; not out of things back in handicap company, although yard also has Star Cast in here.
runners.comment: Winning start for new yard in Windsor maiden latest; not out of things back in h'cap

runners.name: Simply Ruby
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m4f winner for Ed Walker in 2025; off ten months and failed to beat a rival on her yard debut in 1m5f handicap here four weeks ago; cheekpieces are reached for now.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival on yard debut here four weeks ago; cheekpieces are reached for now

runners.name: Boy Named Sioux
runners.spotlight: Gained a first win in 7f Southwell handicap in November but he has failed to kick on subsequently and beat just two in 7f Wolverhampton handicap last time; retried in a hood here.
runners.comment: Gained a first win in 7f Southwell handicap in November but has failed to kick on since
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Northwest Passage
runners.spotlight: Right back on song with second of 18 at York (1m2f) in June but only fifth of eight at Southwell (1m3f) since; needs to bounce back if he's to double his tally here.
runners.comment: Back on song with second at York but only fifth at Southwell since; needs to bounce back

runners.name: Mano Chicago
runners.spotlight: Fair ex-Irish maiden who signed off for Johnny Murtagh with a good second of ten in 1m2f maiden at Ballinrobe in June; since changed hands for 48,000gns and not out of things for in-form yard.
runners.comment: A fair ex-Irish maiden for Johnny Murtagh; not out of things for in-form yard

runners.name: Molinari
runners.spotlight: Winless since 2024 and this veteran has yet to fire in handicaps over C&D and at Newcastle (1m4f) this summer; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Winless since 2024 and this veteran has yet to fire in two handicaps this summer
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing

runners.name: Regalian
runners.spotlight: Started out for current yard with encouraging Redcar sixth in June but he has failed to build on it in a pair of 1m Newcastle handicaps since; needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: Solid Redcar sixth in June but failed to build on it in pair of Newcastle handicaps since

runners.name: Cisco Disco
runners.spotlight: Scored four times here (three over C&D) in 2025; yet to fire this season however and never threatened when sixth of nine over 1m here three weeks ago.
runners.comment: Scored four times here (three over C&D) in 2025; yet to fire this season however

races.race_name: Ladbrokes "Insure Your Acca On Football" Handicap

runners.name: Edmond Halley
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden for Kieran Cotter in Ireland; off over three months before posting an encouraging fifth of nine on yard debut in 5f Catterick handicap 26 days ago, running on late; a player with that run under his belt.
runners.comment: Encouraging fifth on yard debut at Catterick latest; player with that run under his belt

runners.name: Sixcor
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D (fifth course victory) in July and not discredited with fourth of six in 5f classified event at Wolverhampton ten day ago; very much one to consider back here.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D in July; not discredited with Wolverhampton fourth latest; considered

runners.name: Pivotal Terms
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Newcastle (6f) in April but her recent form is not so encouraging, tenth of 12 in 5f handicap there ten days ago; hood goes on now.
runners.comment: Got off the mark at Newcastle (6f) in April but her recent form is not so encouraging

runners.name: Doon The Glen
runners.spotlight: Gained a second success of 2026 at Hamilton (6f) in July; came in last of eight over 5f here a fortnight later, though, and was also disappointing over C&D on Saturday.
runners.comment: Scored at Hamilton (6f) in July but two lesser efforts have followed

runners.name: Henery Hawk
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways at Wolverhampton (5f) in April and largely in good form subsequently, third of eight in 5f handicap here two week ago; can make his presence felt eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Won at Wolverhampton (5f) in April and largely in good form subsequently; considered

runners.name: Monastere
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage Irish 4yo who gained a first success in 6f Fairyhouse handicap in July; below par both subsequent runs however, beating just two at Down Royal (5f) on latter occasion.
runners.comment: Won at Fairyhouse in July but below par both subsequent runs

runners.name: Baby Rover
runners.spotlight: Got back on track with third of seven to Doon The Glen in 6f Hamilton handicap 25 days ago; she needs to back it up now if she's to double her career tally.
runners.comment: Got back on track with third in 6f Hamilton handicap 25 days ago; she needs to back it up
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner

runners.name: Velvet Skies
runners.spotlight: On a losing run but he made a good start for new yard (formerly with Stephen Hanlon) with second of 12 in 7f Wolverhampton handicap 11 days ago; up 2lb but not taken lightly.
runners.comment: Good start for new yard with second at Wolverhampton 11 days ago; not taken lightly

runners.name: Ski Angel
runners.spotlight: Posted a good third over 5f here in June but she's beaten just one rival in two subsequent outings at Hamilton and back here; this course scorer needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Posted a good third over 5f here in June but beaten just one rival in two subsequent runs

runners.name: Red Walls
runners.spotlight: It's now 24 starts since his last victory though he shaped as if the run was needed after five months off when eighth of ten in 6f Wolverhampton handicap last month; needs to build on it.
runners.comment: Off five months before eighth in Wolverhampton handicap last month; needs to build on it

runners.name: Macedonian
runners.spotlight: Arrives out of sorts, tried in cheekpieces when last of nine in 7f Wolverhampton handicap 27 days ago; visor is tried here.
runners.comment: Arrives out of sorts, tried in cheekpieces when last of nine at Wolverhampton 27 days ago

runners.name: Head For Freedom
runners.spotlight: Failed to build on earlier promise with fifth of 14 in 6f Doncaster handicap in June; more is needed if he's to double his tally here.
runners.comment: Failed to build on earlier promise with fifth of 14 in 6f Doncaster handicap in June

runners.name: White Umbrella
runners.spotlight: A dual 6f/7f AW winner in 2025; only eighth of 12 in 7f Wolverhampton handicap 11 days ago, and she's not proving easy to catch right this season.
runners.comment: Eighth at Wolverhampton 11 days ago; she's not proving easy to catch right this season

runners.name: Water Of Leith
runners.spotlight: Scored at Wolverhampton (6f) in March and has largely been in good nick since but needs to rebound from a poor run over 5f here on Saturday.
runners.comment: Scored at Wolverhampton (6f) in March but ran poorly over 5f here on Saturday
runners.owner: Adam Mills And Jonnie Delta Racing

runners.name: Lord Abama
runners.spotlight: On a long losing sequence and yet to hit top form this season, fourth of nine in 6f Thirsk handicap nine days ago; more is required despite a falling mark.
runners.comment: On a long losing sequence and yet to hit top form this season; more is required
runners.owner: Mrs K S Pratt & M Dods

races.race_name: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Recobella
runners.spotlight: In good form this year, most recently when coming from the rear for C&D (good) success five weeks ago; subsequent 3lb rise is offset by Jack Nicholls' claim today; likely contender again.
runners.comment: In good form this year, most recently when coming from the rear for C&D win five weeks ago

runners.name: Idyllic
runners.spotlight: Won twice off marks slightly higher than today's last season (1m3f/1m4f) and was seemingly back in good nick when running-on fourth over C&D (good) last month, but suffered heavy defeat on AW 16 days ago and has become far too inconsistent to rely upon.
runners.comment: Ran on for fourth over C&D two runs ago but far too inconsistent to rely upon

runners.name: Penelope's Sister
runners.spotlight: Won three times over 1m here last season; yet to hit top gear this year but was placed over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago and remains well handicapped; dangerous to ignore.
runners.comment: Not at best this year, but placed over C&D two weeks ago and remains well handicapped

runners.name: King Chaos
runners.spotlight: Scored over extended 1m4f on Tapeta in January and probably found 8.6f too sharp on that surface last month, after a break; should be fine back on turf but others have more persuasive profiles all the same.
runners.comment: Won on Tapeta in January and probably needed his recent run, but others appeal more

runners.name: Lesrico
runners.spotlight: Won on soft ground in the autumn and ran big race in defeat on reappearance outing at Haydock (1m3f, good to soft) in the spring, but disappointed on his next outing (again raced too freely) and is not easy to predict.
runners.comment: Ran big race on seasonal debut in May but absent since disappointing run in June

runners.name: Positive Thoughts
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; kept on for third of six at Hamilton (8.3f, good; wore cheekpieces) last month but safely held on AW since; sports first-time blinkers for first attempt at 1m2f; others appeal more.
runners.comment: 0-8; ran quite well at Hamilton (8.3f) two runs ago; tries new trip and headgear here

runners.name: Naturalia
runners.spotlight: Has modest 2-31 strike-rate but scores good marks for her consistency in recent months, having made the frame five consecutive times (once over C&D); probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Had modest strike-rate but scores good marks for her consistency in recent months

runners.name: Parole Officer
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden who has finished well down the field on all three appearances this season, most recently when 100-1 over C&D (good; first-time cheekpieces) last month.
runners.comment: 11-race maiden who has finished well down the field on all three appearances this season

runners.name: Ravenscraig Castle
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent hurdler who returned to the Flat with respectable fourth (just behind Penelope's Sister) over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago; 1lb lower today and might be better suited by the slightly slower ground; each-way claims at least.
runners.comment: Largely consistent hurdler; fourth over C&D when back on Flat last month; considered
runners.owner: A Sinclair, I Jardine & V Renwick

runners.name: Precious Spartan
runners.spotlight: Did well for new stable last season, winning three times over 1m at Ripon; also suited by 1m2f, but launched this campaign with two low-key runs (7f/1m) and needs a good boost from the new cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Began season with two low-key runs; needs good boost from the new cheekpieces

runners.name: Lightning Galaxy
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden who has basically been disappointing this season (four runs; 6f-1m); moves up in trip with quite a bit to prove.
runners.comment: 12-race maiden who has basically been disappointing this season; tries a new trip

runners.name: She's Got Bottle
runners.spotlight: Regressive mare who was badly out of form when last seen in the autumn; needs to have been revitalised by subsequent break, and could be considered only if attracting market support.
runners.comment: Regressive mare who was badly out of form when last seen in the autumn

races.race_name: Ladbrokes "Free Rewards With Instant Spins" Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Tee Aitch Aye
runners.spotlight: Slow to find his form this season, but his keeping-on third behind Royal Blaze over C&D (good) last month was a big step back in the right direction and he might be seen to even better effect if there's a stronger pace for him to chase today; sports first-time cheekpieces; interesting.
runners.comment: Seemingly back in good form when third over C&D last month; cheekpieces added today

runners.name: Royal Blaze
runners.spotlight: In-form 5yo who won twice over C&D last month (good/good to firm); probably doesn't have much margin for error after latest 4lb rise but ought to be on the premises again.
runners.comment: In-form 5yo who won twice over C&D last month; on fairly tough mark now; still respected

runners.name: Motawaared
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden; didn't run badly when sixth over C&D (good to firm; first run after wind op) three weeks ago and continues to slip down the weights, but needs to find something extra today.
runners.comment: 12-race maiden; didn't run badly over C&D last month but needs to find something extra

runners.name: Spirit Catcher
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form with win off much-reduced mark at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) in April and came second on his next two outings; not seen to best effect when held up in steadily run race at Chester last month, but has quickly dropped back to a workable mark; high on the list.
runners.comment: In good form in the spring; had excuses last time and is quickly back on a workable mark

runners.name: Sweet Kiss
runners.spotlight: Yet to win this season but came from quite a long way off the pace for clear second at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) last month and remains on a workable mark; has possibilities if this race is run to suit.
runners.comment: Came from off the pace for second on AW last month; player if this race is run to suit

runners.name: Ceinture d'Orion
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo; just a respectable fourth of six on handicap debut at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) last month but could quite plausibly still have potential.
runners.comment: Just a respectable fourth of six on last month's handicap debut but remains unexposed

runners.name: Cosmic Man
runners.spotlight: Unable to land a telling blow in his first three handicaps (7f-1m1f); in good hands and not written off just yet, but others in this line-up have much more obvious claims.
runners.comment: Unable to land a telling blow in first three handicaps; others have more obvious claims

runners.name: Rugby Union
runners.spotlight: Made encouraging stable/handicap debut when fifth at Wetherby (1m2f, good to firm) in June, but two lesser efforts have followed and he arrives here with something to prove.
runners.comment: Made encouraging stable/handicap debut in June but two lesser runs followed

runners.name: Glasses Up
runners.spotlight: Veteran who led close home over 1m5f here (good to firm) last month, his 13th success; also suited by this shorter trip, but was effectively 3lb below that last winning mark when only fourth over C&D a week later and his new mark has taken effect; younger rivals look better treated.
runners.comment: Veteran; gained narrow 1m5f win here last month; might be vulnerable off new mark

runners.name: Onyeisi
runners.spotlight: Irish raider; seemingly back in good form when fourth at Fairyhouse (1m2f, good) in June, his third run for Karl Thornton, but has been well beaten twice since.
runners.comment: Seemingly back in good form in June but well beaten twice since

runners.name: West Tyrone
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; started off for new stable with two down-the-field runs over 1m in the spring, but fared much better when third at Carlisle (1m3f, good to soft) in June and remains on a good mark.
runners.comment: Returned to form with third at Carlisle (1m3f) in June and remains on a good mark

runners.name: Farabove The Limit
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; ran fairly well when upped to 1m2f on Tapeta in February but we haven't seen him since; gelded in April; considered only if lively in the betting.
runners.comment: Ran fairly well when upped to 1m2f on Tapeta in February but we haven't seen him since

races.race_name: "Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free" Handicap

runners.name: Keep An Eye On It
runners.spotlight: Finished well to go close on handicap debut at Southwell (7f, AW) in April and he backed that up with a creditable third at Musselburgh (1m, good); returns after 120 days off but he's still unexposed and that latest form has been well advertised by the runner-up since; respected.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo who has been placed in both his handicaps and is respected on return

runners.name: Hatamoto
runners.spotlight: Came good with wins at Beverley (8.4f) and Thirsk (1m, again on good to firm) last month and had an excuse in his hat-trick bid at Southwell (suffered interference) two weeks ago; only 2lb higher than for his last success and he could kick on again back on turf.
runners.comment: Had an excuse in his hat-trick bid at Southwell and he could kick on again back on turf

runners.name: Paroda Diva
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but she returned to form with a win at Haydock (1m, good to soft) in May and backed that up with a good second at Ripon (1m, good) the following month; now goes back up in grade but she's respected off same mark as last time.
runners.comment: Won at Haydock in May before a good second at Ripon last time; respected

runners.name: Vega Storm
runners.spotlight: Unexposed gelding but he's not really progressed and was a well-held sixth behind Wise Crack at Catterick (7f, good to firm) last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: 0-6 and he was a well-held sixth behind Wise Crack at Catterick last time

runners.name: Light The Night Up
runners.spotlight: Reached the frame in her first three handicaps but her form has gone in the wrong direction in two runs this summer; may have been stretched when upped to 1m2f here last time but she's now 0-8 and others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden and her form has gone in the wrong direction in last two starts

runners.name: Napolian
runners.spotlight: Beat a 1-9 shot in a match at Leicester (1m, good to firm) in June, but struggled at York next time before being well held at Beverley 13 days ago; record is now 1-8 and others are more convincing.
runners.comment: Beat a 1-9 shot in a match at Leicester but he's struggled in both runs since

runners.name: Wise Crack
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough with a visor added when finishing well to land a Catterick handicap (7f, good to firm; 18-1) last month; up 3lb but he still looks feasibly treated on that latest form and is open to more progress back up in trip; key player.
runners.comment: Made the breakthrough with a visor added at Catterick and he's respected up 3lb

runners.name: Beckon
runners.spotlight: Won a Newcastle novice (1m, AW) in December but she was vulnerable switched to handicaps in her final two runs for Harry Charlton; changed hands for 22,000gns in April; still lightly raced but she needs resume her progress after 117 days off.
runners.comment: Still lightly raced but she needs more progress for new yard after 117 days off

runners.name: Our Randolph
runners.spotlight: Has a good pedigree but struggled in three novice events, most recently when tailed off on Wetherby reappearance in June; still early days but he needs a transformation on his handicap debut.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo but he needs a transformation on his handicap debut

runners.name: Adiada
runners.spotlight: Her standout effort in three 2yo runs was a close call on soft ground at Beverley (8.4f) on her second start; returns after 293 days off but she should have more to offer now switched to a handicap and it would be a positive if the forecast rain arrives; needs a close look in the market.
runners.comment: Handicap newcomer and she looks interesting on her best 2yo form; dangerous on return

races.race_name: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Greta Tintin
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to 1m AW winner Queen Leila (RPR 62); dam 1m6f Flat (62) and 2m hurdle winner; in a powerful yard so the betting should be instructive.
runners.comment: Half-sister to 1m AW winner Queen Leila (RPR 62); dam 1m6f Flat (62) and 2m hurdle winner

runners.name: Blue Vixen
runners.spotlight: 32,000gns breeze-up buy; by Blue Point; first foal; out of an unraced half-sister to winners Dubai Harbour (1m2f) and Passive Management (US 1m1f); yard is 0-4 with 2yos this season but she might be happier over this trip than some with stouter pedigrees.
runners.comment: 32,000gns breeze-up buy; stable's 2yos 0-4 in 2026 but 7f might suit her better than some

runners.name: Blanquita
runners.spotlight: Second foal; half-sister to 1m2f winner Huggable (RPR 75); dam placed 1m/8.6f AW (70), out of Australian 6f-winning close relative of New Zealand 7f Group 1/Australian 1m Group 2 winner Tavistock; nice pedigree so worth checking in the betting, especially with her yard doubly represented.
runners.comment: Half-sister to 1m2f winner Huggable; nice pedigree so worth checking in the betting

runners.name: Rhythm Of My Heart
runners.spotlight: 14,000gns yearling; third foal; half-sister to 1m4f/1m6f Flat (RPR 90) and 2m hurdle winner St Pancras; dam 1m2f-1m6f winner (109); appeals as one who might do better over longer trips next season but needs checking in the betting; one of two runners for this yard.
runners.comment: Appeals as one who might do better over longer trips next season; yard runs two

runners.name: Singing Blues
runners.spotlight: 32,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 7f winner Fast Society (RPR 92); dam unraced sister to 11.6f winner Nathania; stable's 2yos 1-18 this season and a watching brief makes sense.
runners.comment: 32,000gns yearling; half-sister to 7f winner Fast Society;  yard 1-18 with 2yos in 2026

runners.name: Isabella Of Aragon
runners.spotlight: 12,000gns yearling; twelfth foal; half-sister to five winners including Pursuing The Dream (French 5f 2yo Listed; RPR 100), Izlaz (French Listed-placed 1m/8.5f; 96) and He's A Laddie (5f AW 2yo; 85); dam maiden half-sister to Listed winners at 6f and 1m2f; best watched unless backed.
runners.comment: 12,000gns yearling; twelfth foal; half-sister to 5 winners but best watched unless backed

runners.name: Hidden Beyond
runners.spotlight: Born in Southern Hemisphere in February 2024; second foal; out of a French 1m3f winner, closely related to French 1m4f Listed winner Sacred Spirit; breeding suggests she might be one for further down the line.
runners.comment: Out of a 1m3f winner; breeding suggests she might be one for further down the line

runners.name: Tikka
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Trinquette (French 7f/1m; RPR 100), Candonomore (7f/1m; 88) and Tilak (French 8.5f AW); dam French 7f AW 2yo winner (93); trainer doesn't have many 2yos go in at the first time of asking.
runners.comment: 30,000euros yearling; trainer doesn't have many 2yos go in at the first time of asking

runners.name: Lady Gloriana
runners.spotlight: 2,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to winners Dudley's Boy (1m-1m2f; RPR 88), Lunanova (1m; 72), Gyenyame (Flat/hurdle/chase winner) and Saorla (7f AW; 69); dam 1m 2yo winner (89); others appeal more on paper.
runners.comment: 2,000gns yearling out of a 2yo winner at 1m; others appeal more on paper

runners.name: Alidoolally
runners.spotlight: Third foal; out of a Listed-placed 1m5f winner (RPR 101) and sister to 1m 2yo/12.4f winner Gallifrey; longer trips will suit in time but Saffie Osborne is booked; her yard's first 2yo runner of the season, along with stablemate Rhythm Of My Heart.
runners.comment: Third foal; out of a Listed-placed 1m5f winner (RPR 101); further will suit in time
runners.owner: Kevin Costello And Jane & Andrew Black

runners.name: April's Luck
runners.spotlight: 42,000euros yearling; second foal; dam placed 5f 2yo (RPR 75), half-sister to winners Mgheera (5f Group 2) and Readman (Italian 6f-10.5f); one of two runners from this yard and it's best to let the market guide.
runners.comment: 42,000euros yearling; one of two for the yard and it's best to let the market guide
runners.owner: Nick Bradley Racing 6 & Hold My Beer

runners.name: Nouva Stella
runners.spotlight: 38,000gns yearling; third foal; half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Preanka (RPR 77); dam unraced sister to French 1m2f Listed winner Tresorerie; it's not ideal for a newcomer to be drawn widest over 7f here.
runners.comment: 38,000gns yearling; half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Preanka (RPR 77); drawn widest
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Cxxi And Pls

races.race_name: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D Unraced) (EBF Qual') (GBB Race)

runners.name: Tojoannie
runners.spotlight: Third foal; out of a 1m2f/1m3f winner (RPR 69), half-sister to useful winners Snow Master (7f/1m) and Auld Toon Lune (1m2f); hails from strong yard but disconcerting to see headgear on from the outset.
runners.comment: Hails from strong yard but disconcerting to see headgear on from the outset

runners.name: Thespian Queen
runners.spotlight: 26,000gns yearling; third foal; half-sister to 7f AW winner White Crown Star (RPR 85); dam unraced half-sister to winners Eleonora Duse (1m2f Group 2) and Scottish Stage (1m2f Listed; runner-up in Irish Oaks); one of only two fillies in the field but still one to bear in mind given her yard and pedigree.
runners.comment: One of only two fillies in the field but still one to bear in mind given yard/pedigree

runners.name: Find Your Fire
runners.spotlight: Bought at the breeze-ups for £25,000; half-brother to Italian 6f AW 2yo winner Slide To Glory; dam placed 5.5f-7f in France; stable's newcomers are usually best watched unless backed.
runners.comment: £25,000 breeze-up buy; half-brother to Italian 6f AW 2yo winner Slide To Glory

runners.name: Kiril
runners.spotlight: First foal; out of a 1m AW 2yo winner (sole start; RPR 69), out of unraced sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner Bogart and half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Blaine; already gelded but it makes sense to check the betting vibes.
runners.comment: First foal; out of 1m AW 2yo winner; gelded but it makes sense to check the betting vibes

runners.name: Playfull Warrior
runners.spotlight: 40,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Coconut Cove (Listed-placed 6f AW 2yo; RPR 98) and Serenity Dream (6f/7f; 84); dam 6f AW winner (73), closely related to 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Charming Thought; nicely bred, from a strong 2yo yard and well drawn.
runners.comment: 40,000euros yearling; nicely bred, from a strong 2yo yard and well drawn

runners.name: Reichenbach Falls
runners.spotlight: 6,500gns yearling; second foal; dam placed 6f-9.4f AW (RPR 74), sister to 5f winner Raahy; one of two from this yard.
runners.comment: 6,500gns yearling; second foal; dam placed 6f-9.4f AW (RPR 74)

runners.name: Alam Rayan
runners.spotlight: 45,000euros breeze-up buy; first foal; out of an unraced sister to winners Harlem Nights (7f/1m) and Joolianoss (1m/1m2f); others appeal as more likely winners.
runners.comment: 45,000euros breeze-up buy; out of an unraced sister to two winners at 7f to 1m2f

runners.name: Celtic Storm
runners.spotlight: 45,000euros yearling; seventh foal; closely related to French Listed-placed 1m AW winner Around The World (RPR 96); dam unplaced 7f/1m in France, half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Carry On Katie; stable's 2yos are 5-21 on the AW this year; considered.
runners.comment: 45,000euros yearling; closely related to Listed-placed 1m AW winner Around The World

runners.name: Dreamed
runners.spotlight: 12,000gns yearling; eighth foal; half-brother to winners Show Yourself (5f; RPR 92), Yabrave (6f; 91), Engelbert (7f AW; 84) and Dream Painter (Italian 5.5f-1m1f); dam 7f 2yo winner (87); stable's 2yos are 0-19 this campaign.
runners.comment: 12,000gns yearling; stable's 2yos are 0-19 this campaign

runners.name: Tredegar Square
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-brother to five winners including Heathcliff (Listed-placed 6f/7f AW; RPR 108), Isola Rossa (7f/1m; 94) and Glory Fighter (prolific 5f; 90); dam 6f winner (71), half-sister to smart 5f/6f winner Mazzini; has been gelded; drawn wide but some positives in his pedigree.
runners.comment: Has been gelded and drawn wide, but there are some positives in his pedigree

runners.name: Storm Force Ten
runners.spotlight: 35,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Timiko (1m3f Oaks D'Italia; RPR 103), Aqpan (7f AW; 96) and Batraan (5f/6f; 82); dam unraced sister to 7f/1m 2yo winner Codicil; has been gelded and drawn wide.
runners.comment: 35,000gns yearling; has been gelded and has a wide draw

runners.name: Without Fail
runners.spotlight: 28,000gns breeze-up buy in April; second foal; dam placed 1m2f (RPR 75), sister to useful 10.6f winner Tartlette; one to note in the betting.
runners.comment: 28,000gns breeze-up buy in April; dam placed 1m2f (RPR 75); one to note in the betting

races.race_name: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Lushill
runners.spotlight: Placed on last three appearances, most recently when third in 7f Lingfield maiden on AW debut on Tuesday; upped in trip for this nursery debut; ought to be very competitive again.
runners.comment: Placed on last three starts (6f-7f); up in trip for nursery debut; in the mix again

runners.name: Hamdani Mokhater
runners.spotlight: Disappointing favourite when only third of four at Catterick last month but he went close on nursery debut at Leicester (also 7f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) two starts ago and has good claims if benefiting from the combination of new trip, switch to AW and first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Went close on nursery debut (7f, turf) last month; up in trip for AW debut; considered

runners.name: Bollengo Boy
runners.spotlight: Appeared to show improvement when sixth of seven in 6f Windsor novice a fortnight ago, on third start, but almost certainly needs to kick on again over this new trip on his nursery debut.
runners.comment: Showed only minor promise in 6f maiden/novice races; up in trip for nursery debut

runners.name: Magical Life
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; seems to have some quirks but was beaten under 1l when third in recent Ffos Las nursery (7.3f, good); upped in trip for this AW return; could have a say.
runners.comment: 0-6 and not straightforward but beaten under 1l when third in recent 7.3f turf nursery

runners.name: Lady Miranda
runners.spotlight: Displayed minor promise on last two outings, more recently when fourth of seven at Newbury (6.5f, good to firm) last month; ought to be suited by this longer trip on this nursery debut; a possible.
runners.comment: Displayed minor promise on last two outings (7f/6.5f); a possible on nursery debut

runners.name: Big Bad Storm
runners.spotlight: Showed no promise and was beaten at least 17l on his first three appearances (6f-7f); upped in trip and fitted with first-time visor for this nursery debut.
runners.comment: Showed no promise and was beaten at least 17l on his first three appearances (6f-7f)

runners.name: Ten Of Clubs
runners.spotlight: Well down the field in three 6f novice races and seemingly on a tough mark for this nursery debut; needs the step up in trip to unlock significant improvement.
runners.comment: Well down the field in three 6f novice races; up in trip for nursery debut

runners.name: Emirates Express
runners.spotlight: Nearly 6l behind Magical Life when fifth of ten on recent nursery debut at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) and only 1lb better off with her here; upped in trip and fitted with blinkers for AW debut; clearly needs to improve.
runners.comment: Safely held on recent nursery debut (7.3f); up in trip with blinkers on here

runners.name: Allaboutthelunch
runners.spotlight: Well down the field in his three qualifying races in the spring (5f-7f); makes nursery debut from a basement mark but still needs to take a big step forward; recently gelded.
runners.comment: Well down the field in his three qualifying races in the spring (5f-7f); nursery debut

races.race_name: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap

runners.name: Fallacious Promise
runners.spotlight: Consistent gelding who won well at Lingfield (1m, AW) and with a clear run he might well have followed up off 6lb higher over C&D a month ago (beaten by Roi De Coeur); up another 4lb but he was clear of the third last time and looks a good bet to give his running.
runners.comment: Consistent gelding; won well at Lingfield, then looked unlucky here off 4lb lower

runners.name: Roi De Coeur
runners.spotlight: No good thing to confirm last month's course placings with Fallacious Promise and was found wanting off this 5lb higher mark at Yarmouth since; however, he's heading the right way and Luke Catton claims 3lb.
runners.comment: No good thing to confirm recent course placings with Fallacious Promise; beaten since

runners.name: Berkshire Boom
runners.spotlight: 7f maiden winner at Chester; 0-5 in handicaps and when second there last month he was beaten 8l; beat one home at Sandown subsequently; not wildly appealing.
runners.comment: 7f maiden winner; 0-5 in handicaps and was beaten 8l when second last month
runners.owner: Berkshire Parts & Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub

runners.name: Battosai
runners.spotlight: Left Brian Meehan for 14,000gns; now a nine-race maiden after finishing last of five on yard debut at Leicester (1m).
runners.comment: Now a nine-race maiden after finishing last of the five on yard debut at Leicester (1m)

runners.name: Ballybunion
runners.spotlight: Twice runner-up as 2yo (6f); made some return to form after wind surgery when beaten 3l at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) where he got behind before running on; this extra furlong could benefit.
runners.comment: Not a bad run after wind surgery when running on over 7f at Wolverhampton; 1m could suit
runners.owner: I Foster, D Fish, W Dale & S Dale

runners.name: Alkumatic Jo Jo
runners.spotlight: Has placed form but below par in her last two races and she's now 0-10; others preferred.
runners.comment: Has placed form but below par in her last two races and she's now 0-10; others preferred

runners.name: Mehmas Engine
runners.spotlight: Failed to progress from her debut run (5f, AW) in three further starts for James Tate; sold for 3,400gns in May and was down the field on stable debut here (first-time hood).
runners.comment: Sold for 3,400gns in May and was down the field on stable debut here

runners.name: Something Coming
runners.spotlight: Placed three times, including when a close second in a 7f handicap here on reappearance; that was an improved effort and she's just 2lb higher now.
runners.comment: Placed three times including when a close second in a 7f handicap here on reappearance

runners.name: Mojito
runners.spotlight: Successful handicap debut at Doncaster in the spring (7f, good to firm) but hasn't been close to that level since; moves up to 1m for the first time.
runners.comment: A winner in April but not close to that level since; moves up to 1m for the first time

runners.name: Coxy's Star
runners.spotlight: Has progressed with each run and she was keeping on when close up over 7f at Southwell (AW); this trip should suit on handicap debut and one to bear in mind.
runners.comment: Progressed with each run and was keeping on when close up over 7f at Southwell

runners.name: Athena's War
runners.spotlight: Owned by former trainer Andrew Balding; ran to an ordinary level for him and went in a hood when last seen in March; has much to prove after a break on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Owned by former trainer Andrew Balding; ran to an ordinary level for him

runners.name: Santiago Boy
runners.spotlight: Failed to progress in his qualifying runs and his hopes are pinned on first-time blinkers sparking improvement now switching to a handicap.
runners.comment: Hopes are pinned on first-time blinkers sparking improvement now switching to a handicap

runners.name: Shadowmere
runners.spotlight: Absent for 79 days but he was returning from 223 days off when runner-up on handicap debut at Windsor (1m; made the running); that was his best form yet and he could improve again.
runners.comment: Returning from 223 days off when runner-up on handicap debut at Windsor (1m)

runners.name: Seu Jo
runners.spotlight: 1m AW win in France in March; three heavy defeats in handicaps for this yard (6f-1m) before another one in claiming company.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats in handicaps for this yard (6f-1m) before another one in claiming company

races.race_name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Flightofthephoenix
runners.spotlight: 0-12 but has proved herself capable off higher marks than today's and ran second over 1m2f at Nottingham 11 days ago; kept on well that day and goes up in trip here; considered.
runners.comment: 0-12 but has proved herself capable off higher marks and ran second over 1m2f last time
runners.owner: Old Gold Racing, Tim Cottier & Partner

runners.name: Ghost Story
runners.spotlight: Dual 1m2f winner on ground slower than good; has performed just okay since returning from a break and whether she wants quite this far is open to debate.
runners.comment: Both wins at 1m2f; has performed just okay since returning from a break

runners.name: Hot Silk
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced filly who has been beaten 4l (extended 1m3f) and 2l (1m2f) in her two handicaps; has dropped 3lb and Harry Vigors now takes off another 5lb with his claim; should go well.
runners.comment: Fair runs in both handicaps; dropped 3lb and Harry Vigors takes off another 5lb

runners.name: Celestial Cen
runners.spotlight: Disappointing last time but realistically treated for this handicap debut on her two initial efforts (1m2f); AW debut.
runners.comment: Realistically treated for this handicap debut on her two initial efforts (1m2f); AW debut

runners.name: Kurios Lady
runners.spotlight: Competitive without winning for James Tate, whom she left for 6,000gns; ran well on her previous visit to this track and not without hope.
runners.comment: Competitive without winning for James Tate, whom she left for 6,000gns; has run well here

runners.name: Shirakawa
runners.spotlight: Has won two of her four handicaps (the wins at 1m2f) and attempted to bite her rider's stick last time at Sandown, losing some focus in the process; she wouldn't have won but could have been closer; just 1lb higher now.
runners.comment: Only 1lb higher than when her hat-trick bid came up just short at Sandown

runners.name: Mohaab
runners.spotlight: 1m2f winner on turf in May when 6lb lower; solid runs in defeat since then, latterly over an extended 1m3f when Hot Silk was back in fourth; hasn't been as good on the AW (0-5) but perhaps unwise to count that against her.
runners.comment: 1m2f winner in May and solid in defeat since then; 0-5 on the AW but respected

runners.name: Connie Moon
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden whose best effort was a third of 13 at Goodwood (1m2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in June 2025; opposable on subsequent AW exploits (visored in the last two races) and she's been off since February.
runners.comment: Third at Goodwood last June but opposable on subsequent AW exploits

runners.name: Antiquarian
runners.spotlight: Struggled at big prices in her qualifying runs and this initial mark looks on the high side unless she can find major improvement.
runners.comment: This initial mark looks on the high side unless she can find major improvement

runners.name: Sullom Voe
runners.spotlight: Well held in her first three races (1m2f/1m3f), the latest over C&D; however, she's well bred and should be a different proposition now handicapping at a lowly level.
runners.comment: Should be a different proposition now handicapping at a lowly level

races.race_name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBplus Race)

runners.name: Believitanducan
runners.spotlight: Won at up to almost 2m5f as hurdler so he's a strong stayer; back to the Flat with two wins on good ground (Ascot and Chester) and another on AW at Newcastle in winning the 20-runner Northumberland Vase; up another 5lb (Luke Catton's claim eases 3lb of that) but has track form and strongly considered.
runners.comment: Seeking a four-timer and off a fair mark with Luke Catton taking 3lb off his back

runners.name: Knight Templar
runners.spotlight: Had a productive year over hurdles and on the Flat, last time returning from a break and boxing on for second at Sandown (1m6f); he was bang there over C&D the time before; solid chance.
runners.comment: C&D winner who has had a productive year over hurdles and on the Flat; solid chance

runners.name: Senor Cortez
runners.spotlight: Has turned things around with wins at Southwell (1m6f) and Lingfield (1m5f), latterly defying a penalty by one length; the 4lb rise could find him out in this higher grade and Jack Callan, who was aboard for those wins, no longer claims.
runners.comment: Up the weights for two recent wins and Jack Callan no longer claims; more needed

runners.name: Kingdom Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in successive handicap hurdles before beaten about 11l in a 2m handicap at Chester; has a bit to prove, but encouraging that best Flat form has been on this surface.
runners.comment: Bit to prove but encouraging that best Flat form has been on this surface

runners.name: Desert Belle
runners.spotlight: 1m4f novice winner; 11-4 or shorter when runner-up in her last three handicaps, the latest here when headed late on in first-time cheekpieces; it could be she was in front early enough (travelled well) but unwise to keep making excuses; nudged up 2lb.
runners.comment: 1m4f novice winner; 11-4 or shorter when runner-up in her last three handicaps

runners.name: Killer Whale
runners.spotlight: Progressive AW form (1m-1m4f) and took a strong hold when fourth of six on handicap debut at Doncaster (1m6f); there should be more to come from him.
runners.comment: Took a strong hold when fourth of six on handicap debut at Doncaster; more to come

runners.name: Rock N Roll Pinkie
runners.spotlight: Record of 6-25 on turf but 0-10 on the AW; this year started off okay but after predictably struggling in a Group 3 she's disappointed in a couple of handicaps; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Record of 6-25 on turf but 0-10 on the AW; modest handicap form in last two races

runners.name: Maxident
runners.spotlight: Close up in his one previous run on the AW; dual turf winner on heavy ground over 1m4f and 1m6f; beaten 5l by an exposed 8yo last time at Goodwood (2m, soft) having been clear at one stage; has a big run in him.
runners.comment: 1m4f/1m6f winner; clear at one stage when second at Goodwood latest; respected

runners.name: Double Meaning
runners.spotlight: 1m6f and 2m wins on the AW last season and by clear daylight; excellent third at Newmarket (1m4f) after a break and it wasn't a bad run at Sandown (1m6f) where he hung in the closing stages; could be a factor if bringing his best game.
runners.comment: Impressed on the AW last season; encouraging turf efforts this campaign

runners.name: Barenboim
runners.spotlight: Six AW wins include two here and it was at this venue where he was headed late on over C&D a month ago; he did have the run of things up front that day, though.
runners.comment: Did have the run of things up front when headed late on over C&D a month ago

runners.name: Premiere Ligne
runners.spotlight: Did well in 2024 and then had 592 days off the track; signs of rediscovering his form when 4l behind Believitanducan in the Northumberland Vase (2m AW); dropped 3lb and in the mix.
runners.comment: Signs of rediscovering his form when 4l behind Believitanducan in the Northumberland Vase

runners.name: Scottish Anthem
runners.spotlight: Both wins came in 2022 when trained in France; returning to the Flat for the first time this year when the race was voided at Wolverhampton; he was 50-1 that day.
runners.comment: 50-1 when returned to the Flat in a voided race at Wolverhampton

races.race_name: Find Us At fitzdares.com Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Mythological Star
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 3yo who justified odds-on favouritism when scoring on handicap debut at Ffos Las (1m, good; front pair clear) on Tuesday; bred to be suited by today's step up in trip and probably still well treated under 6lb penalty; makes obvious appeal.
runners.comment: Upped from 1m after winning handicap debut on Tuesday; still well treated under penalty

runners.name: Hello Cotai
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D (good to firm) in June and was close third off today's mark at Epsom (1m2f, good) last month; needs to bounce back from a lesser effort a fortnight later but still enters calculations.
runners.comment: C&D winner in June; below form on latest outing but still enters calculations

runners.name: Just An Hour
runners.spotlight: Consistent 6yo who was placed at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm) last month and remains 1lb lower than when scoring over C&D (good to firm) just over a year ago; ought to be right in the thick of things.
runners.comment: Consistent 6yo who was placed at Newbury last month and was a C&D winner last summer

runners.name: Post Rider
runners.spotlight: Ought to be suited by combination of drop back in trip and return to turf, but has not been firing on all cylinders this season and has a lot more to prove than some of these.
runners.comment: Not firing on all cylinders this season and has a lot more to prove than some of these

runners.name: Shady Bay
runners.spotlight: Looked as good as ever when scoring in good style on seasonal debut at Nottingham (1m2f, good) in April but subsequent efforts, though respectable, suggest she's a shade vulnerable off her current mark.
runners.comment: Won on seasonal debut but may be a shade too high in the weights now
runners.owner: P Afia, E Hobson, A Pegley, C&r Russell

runners.name: Golden Circet
runners.spotlight: Pretty consistent on the Flat and over hurdles this year and has dropped 1lb since his recent fourth at Epsom (1m2f, good to firm); visor (worn for last four races) is left off here; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Pretty consistent on the Flat and over hurdles this year; probably won't be far away
runners.owner: W Trenchard, A Coupland, Cheam Marketng

races.race_name: Fitzdares Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Harry Knows
runners.spotlight: Delivered on earlier promise when emphatic winner of C&D (good to firm) novice in first-time cheekpieces a fortnight ago and has the services of Oisin Murphy again for this nursery debut; commands respect.
runners.comment: Makes nursery debut after emphatic C&D success a fortnight ago and commands respect
runners.owner: Thames Boys, J Henwood & J Clay

runners.name: Everatease
runners.spotlight: Won two quite valuable sellers (both 6f, good) this spring, but was soundly beaten after racing too freely on recent nursery debut at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good to firm); in calmer waters here and may benefit from the drop back in trip, but others have more convincing claims.
runners.comment: This is easier than recent Goodwood nursery he contested but others appeal more

runners.name: This Moment
runners.spotlight: Showed similar level of form in all three novice races, most recently when close second at Ffos Las (6f, good) six weeks ago; gelded in the meantime; open to improvement in nurseries.
runners.comment: Close second in two of his three novice races; open to improvement in nurseries
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: El Lambo
runners.spotlight: Won Bath maiden (5.7f, firm) by wide margin in May, but was last of six after refusing to settle in C&D nursery won by Keep Kicking On three weeks ago; now has a point to prove.
runners.comment: Maiden winner in May; last of six after refusing to settle over C&D last month
runners.owner: The Lamb Inn Wantage Racing Team

runners.name: Keep Kicking On
runners.spotlight: Kept on well to make winning nursery debut over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; subsequent 5b rise demands more from him but he still needs to be taken very seriously.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D on nursery debut three weeks ago; up 5lb; respected

races.race_name: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Wateera
runners.spotlight: Made all for a comfortable win on Wetherby debut (5.5f, good to firm) in June and she built on that when going very close under a penalty at Newbury (6f, good to firm) 19 days later; sets a good standard on that form and she could be hard to catch.
runners.comment: Won on Wetherby debut before a near-miss over 6f at Newbury; strong contender

runners.name: Real Bullet
runners.spotlight: Mehmas colt who finished well for a last-gasp debut win over C&D (good to firm) last month; pulled almost 4l clear with the runner-up in that race and he should improve for that experience; strongly respected under a penalty.
runners.comment: Finished well for a last-gasp win on C&D debut last month; respected under penalty

runners.name: Aksel
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; gelded brother to winners Nordic Glory (prolific 5f/6f including 2yo; RPR 77) and A Lott Of Kane (5f/6f AW; 58); dam 5f 2yo winner (76), sister to 6.5f Listed winner Princedargent and useful 1m-1m2f winner Erik The Red; this looks a tough starting point and he's best watched.
runners.comment: Already gelded and this looks a tough starting point; best watched

runners.name: Major Looktwice
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling, 45,000euros breeze-up 2yo; Mehmas half-brother to three winners, notably Gavota (Group-placed 6f/7f 2yo; RPR 105); dam unraced; has good target to aim at on debut and market should guide.
runners.comment: 45,000euros breeze-up 2yo; has good target to aim at on debut and market should guide

runners.name: Parkers Light
runners.spotlight: Finished down the field on Bath debut (5.7f, firm) last month and he was beaten 19l when last of five at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) last time.
runners.comment: Down the field on Bath debut last month and he was beaten 19l at Nottingham last time

runners.name: Goldtrader
runners.spotlight: Weak 11-1 shot and he ran green before finishing a remote last of nine at Salisbury (5f, good) in May; returns after a break and he needs a transformation upped in trip on his second start.
runners.comment: Weak 11-1 shot and he didn't show much on his Salisbury debut in May

races.race_name: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap

runners.name: Indian Run
runners.spotlight: Lost his way as a 3yo but he had smart 6f handicap form last May and a close second to Diligently over C&D (good to firm) in June signalled a return to better days; a Thirsk win at 6f and a close third over 5f at Ascot have followed and he can be in the thick of it.
runners.comment: Smart 6f handicap form last May; back to form this summer; can be in the thick of it

runners.name: Another Abbot
runners.spotlight: Has plenty of handicapping experience but better than ever when winning quite convincingly over C&D (good to firm) recently; on a career-high mark against stronger opposition but it's not too late for him to do better.
runners.comment: Plenty of experience in handicaps but better than ever over C&D latest; may do better yet

runners.name: Diligently
runners.spotlight: Has had some ups and downs in handicaps but is 2-3 in them over C&D (latest win when getting the better of Indian Run in June) and was seriously impeded in the other; has claims with Billy Loughnane up for the first time.
runners.comment: Two from three in C&D handicaps and hampered in the other; B Loughnane up for first time

runners.name: Justcallmepete
runners.spotlight: Just 3-26 on turf but this C&D does work well for him and he gained a deserved first win on the track when just fending off Uncle Don (good to firm) in May; has had going (good to soft) and trip (5f) excuses since but this company could be overwhelming.
runners.comment: Just 3-26 on turf but this C&D works well for him; had excuses since May win; more needed

runners.name: Uncle Don
runners.spotlight: Sole win in a Beverley maiden over two years ago but he only just failed to gain a first handicap win when touched off by Justcallmepete over C&D (good to firm) in May; some way below that level in Diligently's race here the following month, though, and others are higher up the list.
runners.comment: Sole win in 2024; just lost out over C&D in May but lesser effort here the following month

runners.name: King Of Light
runners.spotlight: Has raced mostly at around 5f but there was no doubting that this C&D suited him well when he won by a wide margin (good to firm) in June; ran with great credit when eighth of 27 in the Stewards' Cup at Goodwood recently, after having to be switched, and looks a likely contender back here.
runners.comment: Wide-margin C&D winner in June; good 8th in the Stewards' Cup recently when back over 6f

runners.name: Purest Time
runners.spotlight: Smart on his day, as when runner-up to a top 6f handicapper at York (good) last October, and he saw off Desert Cop, Badri and Diligently in some style over C&D in May, despite being switched twice; not so good in two runs since but he's too talented to overlook back on this track.
runners.comment: Smart on his day; won in some style over C&D in May; less good since but possible reviver

runners.name: Star Chorus
runners.spotlight: One turf win from 15 attempts, in a four-runner race at Chepstow (5f) last July; two fair C&D runs since returned to turf in May and was out on a limb when finishing sixth to Another Abbot and Sudden Flight 14 days ago; however, he'll do well to win at this level off his current mark.
runners.comment: 1-15 on turf; two fair C&D runs in 2026, 6th to Another Abbot latest; tough task today

runners.name: Desert Cop
runners.spotlight: Took advantage of a more favourable mark when winning over this C&D (good to firm) in June, a first win in Britain for over two years; perhaps downhill tracks weren't so helpful in two runs since, at 6f and 5f, but he still has something to find in this company.
runners.comment: Took advantage of weights drop over C&D in June; has more to prove in this better race

runners.name: Sudden Flight
runners.spotlight: Both wins on AW; 0-9 on grass but cheekpieces seem to have bucked him up of late and he was very close to breaking his turf duck at Salisbury before making late inroads into Another Abbot's lead over this C&D last time; weighted to be thereabouts with that one and can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Both wins on AW; 0-9 on turf but close with Another Abbot on C&D form last time

runners.name: Dream Composer
runners.spotlight: Multiple wins include two over 5f for new yard this year, the first under Myla Coppins and the second on this track; did win once over 6f back in 2022 but it's a long time since he played a part over this trip.
runners.comment: Multiple wins over 5f, two for new yard; long time since he's played a part over 6f

runners.name: Badri
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who has had a fantastic run this year, winning his last four races on good to firm ground, over 6f and 5f; at the age of nine he seems to be closing in on his best-ever form and he has won off a slightly higher mark than today's in the past; Oisin Murphy up for the first time; much respected.
runners.comment: C&D winner; won his last 4 races on good to firm, at 6f and 5f; O Murphy up for first time

runners.name: Rosario
runners.spotlight: Both wins over 5f; stays further, having finished better than anything when third of 21 in the Portland at Doncaster (extended 5f, good) last September but this is only his second run in a 6f turf handicap (faded in the first of them) so still has stamina to prove.
runners.comment: Both wins at 5f; stays further but he faded in his only previous 6f turf handicap

runners.name: Cindy Lou Who
runners.spotlight: Four wins on extremes of going in 2025, including over C&D, but she surpassed them all in form terms when just losing out in a Listed race at Bath in April; had a rough ride from the handicapper as a result and she's found it all too much since; up against it.
runners.comment: C&D winner; best form when 2nd in Listed race in April but on a high mark now as a result

runners.name: Baldomero
runners.spotlight: Saw out 2025 with three AW wins from his final four starts but he's played only minor roles in turf handicaps this year, including when beaten nearly 5l behind King Of Light over C&D in May; could do with some rain or, failing that, a return to the AW as he's well treated now.
runners.comment: Three AW wins from final four runs in 2025; just minor roles on turf since; well treated

runners.name: Trefor
runners.spotlight: Had two C&D wins under his belt before finishing close up in the last two runnings of this (both on good to firm); not ideally placed when returned to this track in May but he should have a say again now back on a better mark, 3lb lower than last August.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins; close up in the 2024 running and narrow defeat in this last year; involved
runners.owner: Julie Martin & David R Martin & Partner

races.race_name: Fitzdares Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Princess Honey Bee
runners.spotlight: Promising debut third at Yarmouth (7f) for previous trainer and can't be entirely blamed for later defeats that year; two fair efforts for new yard, finding only a well-supported newcomer too good at Ripon (1m, good to firm) recently; looks competitive under Billy Loughnane, who's 1-4 for the yard.
runners.comment: Two fair efforts (7f and 1m) for new yard; can be very competitive under Billy Loughnane

runners.name: Sterling Fortune
runners.spotlight: All four runs over 7f with some signs of ability, albeit not looking to be crying out for the extra furlong despite several siblings having won at about this trip; still can't be written off in an ordinary race.
runners.comment: Signs of ability over 7f; bred to improve for 1m and this is an ordinary race

runners.name: Somethingintheair
runners.spotlight: Improved as a 2yo, running an eye-catching race when making late headway into fifth on Lingfield AW on final start (first three have done well in handicaps since); never able to threaten at Ffos Las (1m, good) only last week on her belated return but she should progress.
runners.comment: Improved with racing as 2yo; never threatened on belated reappearance but should progress

runners.name: Moonswept
runners.spotlight: First foal; by Sea The Moon out of unraced half-sister to winners Furrion (useful Australian 6.5f-11.7f), Open The Red (1m2f; 83) and Elterwater (1m-1m2f; 81); interesting newcomer for in-form yard that has a healthy 14% strike-rate in maidens (11-78); market can guide.
runners.comment: Likely type on debut for yard with healthy 11-78 strike-rate in maidens; market can guide

runners.name: Gift Box
runners.spotlight: 10,000gns foal; first foal; by Sergei Prokofiev out of winner at 7f-8.6f (RPR 78), half-sister to multiple winner Fiscal Policy (5f/6f) and Dittander (5f 2yo); likely best watched on debut as yard has a better record in handicaps than at this level.
runners.comment: Nice enough pedigree but yard has a better record with handicappers than in maidens

runners.name: Thunder Goddess
runners.spotlight: Never in the picture in two AW races at 1m (22-1) and about 1m1f (50-1); seems unlikely to suddenly sprout wings in a maiden.
runners.comment: Well held in two AW races at 1m and about 1m1f; unlikely to sprout wings at this level

runners.name: Mystic Music
runners.spotlight: 33-1 for two AW starts over 1m and 1m4f, finishing 20l and 30l behind the winner; heading for modest handicaps off a lowly mark after today.
runners.comment: 33-1 for two AW starts over 1m and 1m4f, finishing 20l and 30l behind the winner

runners.name: Dayna
runners.spotlight: Big prices when she finished last of five this summer over 1m at Ripon and 7f at Lingfield; likely to show more when qualified for run-of-the-mill handicaps.
runners.comment: Last of 5 in both starts, over 1m and 7f; run-of-the-mill handicaps will be more suitable

races.race_name: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap

runners.name: Creciente
runners.spotlight: Clearcut winner of Lingfield classified (7f, good to firm) under Oisin Murphy last month, her tenth start, and went very close off today's mark in recent handicap over that C&D; reunited with the champion jockey for this first attempt at 1m; must be considered.
runners.comment: In good form over 7f lately; reunited with Oisin Murphy for this first attempt at 1m

runners.name: My Old Mate
runners.spotlight: Came good at seventh attempt, readily making all over C&D six weeks ago; that form has been well advertised by the clear runner-up since and this fellow could still be well handicapped after a 5lb rise.
runners.comment: Readily made all over C&D six weeks ago, form well advertised by the runner-up since

runners.name: Torbados
runners.spotlight: Ran quite well from the front when upped to 1m at Kempton (AW) last month, but managed only sixth when favourite at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) three weeks ago; now 0-10 and needs to find something extra on this turf return.
runners.comment: Only sixth when favourite on AW last time and now 0-10; needs to find something extra

runners.name: Karisma's Angel
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden after six starts, but posted good effort when third at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last month and looks well worth another crack at 1m; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Posted good effort over 7f last month and looks well worth another crack at 1m; considered

runners.name: Mr Jeffrey
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who was safely held in Lingfield classified events on last two outings (7.6f/7f), latterly in race won by Creciente; needs significant improvement on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Safely held in classified races on last two outings; significant improvement required

runners.name: Bennyworth
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden who was behind Ingemar when well-held fourth of six at Sandown (1m, good to firm) 12 days ago; difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: Ten-race maiden who was well held when fourth of six at Sandown recently

runners.name: Landslide
runners.spotlight: Seemed to find things happening too quickly when dropped back to 6f for recent handicap debut, finishing only sixth of eight, but remains unexposed and his pedigree suggests this new trip will suit; cheekpieces removed but hood remains.
runners.comment: Found things happening too quickly over 6f on handicap debut; tries a new trip here

runners.name: Neat And Tidy
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all five starts, most recently when well-held fifth on stable debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) three weeks ago; moves up in trip here; may yet come good for Richard Hughes but others have more obvious claims.
runners.comment: Unplaced all five starts, most recently when well-held fifth; upped from 7f today

runners.name: Ingemar
runners.spotlight: Drops in grade after respectable third of six on recent handicap debut at Sandown (1m, good to firm; first-time hood), but displays an ungainly head carriage and needs to learn to settle better; others look safer.
runners.comment: Drops in grade after respectable third on handicap debut but does not look straightforward

runners.name: Fizzy Bear
runners.spotlight: Unexposed after only four starts, but absent since 21l defeat on handicap debut at Kempton (1m, AW) in May; leap of faith required to support him.
runners.comment: Absent since 21l defeat on handicap debut in May; leap of faith required to support him

races.race_name: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Sofi's Gift
runners.spotlight: Weak Flat form; overcame some interference to finish a promising second on hurdles debut at Limerick; has an edge over Nicky Larson and Words Unspoken; stable in great form with a treble at Kilbeggan on Saturday.
runners.comment: Weak Flat form, overcame some interference to finish a promising second on hurdles debut

runners.name: No Bother Aoife
runners.spotlight: Rated 51 on the Flat after seven runs; fair fourth on hurdles debut at Killarney but looks held by runner-up Minella Buoy.
runners.comment: Modest Flat form, fair fourth on hurdles debut at Killarney but looks held by Minella Buoy

runners.name: Minella Buoy
runners.spotlight: Beat very few rivals in three Flat maidens last year; sixth of 14 on Flat handicap debut at Gowran; stepped up on his modest Flat form when second on hurdles debut at Killarney, solid chance
runners.comment: Stepped up on his modest Flat form when second on hurdles debut at Killarney, solid chance

runners.name: Nicky Larson
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability on the Flat, rated 65, made the frame in two handicaps; split Sofi's Gift and Words Unspoken when third at Limerick on hurdles debut.
runners.comment: Showed some ability on the Flat, 1 1/2l behind Sofi's Gift at Limerick on hurdles debut

runners.name: Words Unspoken
runners.spotlight: Not far behind Sofi's Guest and Nicky Larson at Limerick; has more to find with Minella Buoy, No Bother Aoife and Divelment on Killarney running.
runners.comment: Not far behind two of these rivals at Limerick, finished behind three others at Killarney

runners.name: Divine Believer
