runners.spotlight: 61-rated maiden on the Flat; has questions to answer after his two most recent starts, last of eight at Leopardstown and seventh of nine at this venue; coming from this source, quite possible she will improve considerably for the switch to jumping.
runners.comment: 61-rated maiden on the Flat, has questions to answer after his two most recent starts

runners.name: Motherland
runners.spotlight: Third foal; Sioux Nation gelding is a brother to a Polish 7f winner, half-brother to Polish 1m 2yo winner; dam, by Wootton Bassett, French 1m 2yo winner, half-sister to Flat/hurdle/chase winner Fast Buck.
runners.comment: Newcomer from a top stable with a fine record in this age-group, decent Flat pedigree

runners.name: Sands Castle
runners.spotlight: Second at this track in June was the highlight of her Flat form; disappointing when favourite at Gowran last time; hooded now.
runners.comment: Second at this track in June was the highlight of her Flat form, disappointing last time

runners.name: Nod Of Approval
runners.spotlight: Fair 75-rated maiden on the Flat; interesting juvenile hurdle prospect on pedigree, being a half-brother to useful jumpers Puturhandstogether and Showurappreciation.
runners.comment: Fair 75-rated maiden on the Flat, interesting juvenile hurdle prospect on pedigree

runners.name: Camp Verde
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to Arizona to a Scandinavian Flat/hurdles winner; dam unraced; best watched.
runners.comment: Half-brother to Arizona to a Scandinavian Flat/hurdles winner, dam unraced, best watched

runners.name: Mount Eden
runners.spotlight: Modest Flat form for Donnacha O'Brien; will need to step up from hurdling debut at Hexham; third in a six-runner, the second has won two small-field events since then.
runners.comment: Modest Flat form for Donnacha O'Brien, needs to step up from hurdling debut at Hexham

runners.name: Divelment
runners.spotlight: Placed on the Flat at Roscommon last year and twice on AW earlier this year; held by Minella Buoy and No Bother Aoife on running over hurdles at Killarney.
runners.comment: Placed three times on the Flat, held by Minella Buoy on running over hurdles at Killarney

runners.name: Connor Of Mali
runners.spotlight: Jumped poorly and pulled up at Limerick on debut; tailed off in the Killarney race in which Minella Buoy was second.
runners.comment: Jumped poorly at Limerick, tailed off in Killarney race in which Minella Buoy was second

races.race_name: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: How's Ellie
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite but not a bad run in first bumper at Galway last October, beaten 9l in fifth; not as good next time at Tramore; unfancied when a moderate sixth on hurdles debut at Roscommon; still looked raw when second at this venue last month; capable of picking up a modest race.
runners.comment: Still looked raw when second at this venue last month, capable of picking up a modest race

runners.name: Texas Red
runners.spotlight: Fair bumper form last year for Ronnie O'Leary; mildly encouraging hurdles debut for new yard at Downpatrick; will not need to improve much from his Kilbeggan fourth to feature here; cheekpieces added
runners.comment: Will not need to improve much from his Kilbeggan fourth to feature here, cheekpieces added
runners.owner: John Henry & William Bates & Paul Hillis

runners.name: Be My Fortune
runners.spotlight: Some promise in points for Rob James; hard to be confident after a poor bumper run at Downpatrick on his first start for Gordon Elliott.
runners.comment: Some promise in points, hard to be confident after a poor bumper run at Downpatrick

runners.name: Lexenna
runners.spotlight: No encouragement can be taken from her bumper runs at Limerick and Sligo.
runners.comment: No encouragement can be taken from her bumper runs at Limerick and Sligo

runners.name: Kalinka de Loire
runners.spotlight: Three failures to complete in point-to-points; tongue-tie on for racecourse debut; reserve.
runners.comment: Reserve, three failures to complete in point-to-points, tongue-tie on for racecourse debut

runners.name: Sea Limit
runners.spotlight: Remote sixth on her only point-to-point start; some positives in the pedigree, sister to a bumper/chase winner, half-sister to two other winners.
runners.comment: Remote sixth on her only point-to-point start, some positives in the pedigree

runners.name: Crystal Mariner
runners.spotlight: Four wins in Britain, best on AW; reached a peak rating of 85 after two Kempton wins last year; not at his best in recent months; however, he is race-fit and the bar is set low for his hurdles debut; interesting.
runners.comment: Four Flat wins in Britain, best on AW, bar is set low for his hurdles debut, interesting

runners.name: Rockstar Rebel
runners.spotlight: Hillstar gelding whose dam (by Beneficial) won a bumper and a maiden hurdle.
runners.comment: Hillstar gelding whose dam (by Beneficial) won a bumper and a maiden hurdle

runners.name: Salty Racer
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten when fourth of five finishers in a point; positives in the pedigree; brother to bumper winner Getaway Vic, half-brother to hurdle/chase winner Lightkeeper; dam bumper and useful hurdle/chase winner.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten when fourth of five finishers in a point, positives in the pedigree

runners.name: Boo Radley
runners.spotlight: Started favourite for a Roscommon bumper last August, well beaten, found to be blowing hard; raced keenly when again a beaten favourite at Tramore in October, very tame effort on hurdles debut at Sligo last month; tongue-tie on now; trainer also runs How's Ellie.
runners.comment: Has failed to live up to market expectations in three races, trainer also runs How's Ellie
runners.owner: Brian M Keenan & P W Mullins

runners.name: Discrete
runners.spotlight: Weak overall form in points after debut third; in rear in a Kilbeggan bumper in June.
runners.comment: Weak overall form in points after debut third, in rear in a Kilbeggan bumper in June

runners.name: Leva Deva
runners.spotlight: Two runs at Sligo, pulled up in a maiden hurdle and tailed off in a bumper.
runners.comment: Two runs at Sligo, pulled up in a maiden hurdle and tailed off in a bumper.

runners.name: Trev The Rev
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in maiden hurdles at Limerick and Galway, massive odds on both occasions.
runners.comment: Pulled up in maiden hurdles at Limerick and Galway, massive odds on both occasions

runners.name: Certosa
runners.spotlight: Weak form in bumpers and over hurdles; big price when a remote fifth at Limerick in May.
runners.comment: Weak form in bumpers and over hurdles, big price when a remote fifth at Limerick in May

runners.name: Tiffany Case
runners.spotlight: Reported to be blowing after her debut at Ballinrobe, a long way behind How's Ellie then; probably capable of much better, needs to provide reassurance.
runners.comment: Reported to be blowing after her debut at Ballinrobe, a long way behind How's Ellie then

runners.name: Hurling Academy
runners.spotlight: Soldier Of Fortune gelding; half-brother to 2m hurdle winner Harty Cup; dam bumper/2m4f hurdle winner, half-sister to useful chase winner Sraid Padraig; Never involved first time out at Kilbeggan, likely to need more experience, in good hands.
runners.comment: Never involved first time out at Kilbeggan, likely to need more experience, in good hands

races.race_name: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Le Diablo
runners.spotlight: Won 2m1f Clonmel handicap in April (yielding); has been kept busy; second over 2m1f at Wexford, fair third behind Max Meridius over a slightly longer trip at this venue; needs to bounce back from a poor run at Cork last week.
runners.comment: Had seemed in fair form before a poor run at Cork last week, placed twice in July

runners.name: Ripsnorter
runners.spotlight: Roscommon bumper winner a year ago for Andy Slattery; may find his level now after three maiden hurdle runs; needs to settle better.
runners.comment: Roscommon bumper winner a year ago, may find his level now after three maiden hurdle runs

runners.name: Secret Rock
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner in 2023 and also recorded two Flat wins for Tony Martin; won a Kilbeggan handicap on stable debut in May, when returning from a 214-day break; failed to back that up at Killarney last month.
runners.comment: Winner on stable debut at Kilbeggan in May, failed to back that up at Killarney last month

runners.name: Theanniversary Man
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back handicap hurdles at Thurles (2m) and Cork (2m4f) late last year; 2026 form is less persuasive, though the form of his Sligo fourth was boosted significantly by the winner Timurshah in winning twice at the Galway festival.
runners.comment: Won back-to-back handicap hurdles late last year, 2026 form is less persuasive

runners.name: Go To Town
runners.spotlight: Cheekpieces on now after a below-par Sligo run last week; respectable form before that, fourth in races at Clonmel and Sligo.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces on now after a below-par Sligo run last week, respectable form before that

runners.name: Koeur A Prendre
runners.spotlight: Left modest maiden form behind to run a fine race when second on handicap debut at Clonmel in May; showed a similar standard of form when runner-up at Killarney; both those races have been over further, and this trip might not be ideal; holds a leading chance all the same.
runners.comment: Holds a leading chance based on second placings at Clonmel and Killarney in recent months

runners.name: Chemdawg
runners.spotlight: Took a long time to win a race over hurdles but has been in fine form in recent months; deserved her breakthrough win at Kilbeggan; suffered interference when chasing home an easy winner at Limerick; transferred her form to the Flat when second at 25-1 in a 1m4f contest at the same venue; good chance off a light weight.
runners.comment: In good form over hurdles before a fine effort on the Flat at Limerick, strong contender

runners.name: Long Gone
runners.spotlight: Won a bumper and two hurdles for Declan Queally; yet to hit form for this stable; pulled up at Downpatrick in June; visor on now.
runners.comment: Won a bumper and two hurdles for Declan Queally, yet to hit form for this stable

runners.name: Houndsworth
runners.spotlight: Shock winner at Cork in April (2m, yielding); mid-field off revised mark at Limerick later that month, when testing ground may not have suited; unplaced favourite in a novice contest at Downpatrick; moderate run at this venue last month, jumped untidily at times.
runners.comment: Shock winner at Cork in April, unplaced at this venue last month, jumped untidily at times

runners.name: Fremantle Doctor
runners.spotlight: Flashes of form over hurdles and fences during a light campaign in 2025; first run since March; not one of the more obvious contenders.
runners.comment: Flashes of form over hurdles and fences, not one of the more obvious contenders

runners.name: Atlantic Gamble
runners.spotlight: Six wins on the Flat; no sign of an equivalent standard in six starts over hurdles, the most recent at this venue in May.
runners.comment: Six wins on the Flat, no sign of an equivalent standard in six starts over hurdles

runners.name: Brave Crogha
runners.spotlight: 200-1 bumper winner at the 2024 Galway festival; no sign of winning potential over hurdles at this stage; 50-1 when pulled up here in May.
runners.comment: 200-1 bumper winner at the 2024 Galway festival, no sign of winning potential over hurdles

runners.name: Final Decision
runners.spotlight: Won a Kilbeggan bumper in 2023; has struggled over hurdles after two lengthy absences; tailed off at Wexford in May, same at this venue on her only 2025 start.
runners.comment: Won a Kilbeggan bumper in 2023, has struggled over hurdles after two lengthy absences

runners.name: Figero
runners.spotlight: Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner; possible to excuse his handicap hurdle debut at Tramore; ran respectably in a Flat maiden here three weeks ago.
runners.comment: Kilbeggan maiden winner, excuses at Tramore in first handicap, fair Flat run here recently

races.race_name: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Cool Summer
runners.spotlight: Placed in a maiden last summer; improved considerably from her first handicap at Listowel when second at Roscommon five weeks ago; beaten 7l but did well to recover from interference which caused her to become unbalanced before three out.
runners.comment: Overcame mishaps in running to take second at Roscommon last time, could feature now

runners.name: Sidiriya
runners.spotlight: Flat winner has run creditably in defeat recently; started slowly at Sligo and did well to stay on and take third; went one place better at Clonmel; doubt raised by unplaced run at Wexford last time.
runners.comment: Flat winner, unplaced last time, fair chance based on previous runs at Sligo and Clonmel

runners.name: Home By The Sea
runners.spotlight: Out of his depth in a Flat maiden at Galway; struggled at Killarney in his first handicap hurdle, last of 15.
runners.comment: Out of his depth in a Flat maiden at Galway, struggled in his first handicap hurdle

runners.name: Max Meridius
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle over a furlong further here last month, with Le Diablo back in third; last week's Cork run looked too bad to be true.
runners.comment: Last week's Cork run looked too bad to be true, emphatic course winner last month

runners.name: Let Him B
runners.spotlight: Progressive handicap hurdler in March/April; won over 2m5f at Down Royal (yielding) and better again off 11lb higher when clear second over 2m4f at Limerick; questions to answer after his last two starts, one of which was over fences.
runners.comment: Looked progressive March/April, questions to answer after his last two  starts

runners.name: Bangor Lady
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in four outings this season, three of them handicaps; hard to make a case for her.
runners.comment: Well beaten in four outings this season, three of them handicaps, hard to make a case

runners.name: Grey Gardens
runners.spotlight: Promising effort at Down Royal in his first handicap; two slightly less encouraging runs since, both at Wexford; fair chance in this grade with 5lb claimed.
runners.comment: Promising effort at Down Royal in his first handicap, two less encouraging runs since

runners.name: Victoria Kesia
runners.spotlight: Flat winner ran her best race over hurdles when a distant third of 14 on handicap hurdle debut at Downpatrick (2m2f, good); has produced two much less encouraging displays since then.
runners.comment: Flat winner, has produced two much less encouraging displays since a Downpatrick third

runners.name: The Toothpicker
runners.spotlight: A couple of encouraging efforts last season after returning from a long absence, notably when fifth of 24 at Cork (2m4f, soft to heavy); soundly beaten when filling the same place at Kilbeggan in April.
runners.comment: Fifth on three occasions during March/April, needs to improve to gain a breakthrough win

runners.name: Lunar Landscape
runners.spotlight: Placed six times on the Flat; relatively unexposed over hurdles; needs to find extra judged on his handicap attempts at Wexford and Cork.
runners.comment: Placed six times on the Flat, relatively unexposed over hurdles, needs to find extra

runners.name: The Vegas Raider
runners.spotlight: Three wins on the Flat; 1-18 over hurdles, with that sole success coming in this race two years ago; had a long layoff before returning at Limerick early last month, struggling when unseating rider three out.
runners.comment: Won this race in 2024, unseated rider three out at Limerick on first run after long layoff

runners.name: Sayitfirst
runners.spotlight: Potentially well handicapped relative to her best chase form; good form in that sphere last October when backing up a Sligo win with seconds at Tramore and Down Royal; might need the run, her first since out of her depth in a Grade 2 mares' chase at Cork last December; 13lb lower than her chase mark
runners.comment: Potentially well handicapped relative to her best chase form, might need the run
runners.owner: Profit In Your Pocket Racing Club

runners.name: Spread The Faith
runners.spotlight: Badly out of form over hurdles before a satisfactory chase debut at Limerick in May; others are more appealing.
runners.comment: Badly out of form over hurdles before a satisfactory chase debut at Limerick in May

runners.name: Ikalimix
runners.spotlight: 50-1 shot when falling at the fifth at Cork in his first handicap; can be ruled out; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, 50-1 shot when falling at the fifth at Cork in his first handicap

runners.name: Euro Maker
runners.spotlight: Promising second handicap attempt when chasing home a 6l winner in a 20-runner 2m Cork contest in April, having made much of the running; possible excuse for a poor Wexford run in May, hampered by a loose horse and may have lost confidence.
runners.comment: Possible excuse for a poor Wexford run in May, previous Cork second was encouraging

runners.name: Calm Flight Ahead
runners.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; cheekpieces failed to produce any improvement when pulled up last time on handicap debut; blinkers tried now; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, cheekpieces failed to produce any improvement last time, blinkers tried now
runners.owner: Miss Phidelma Elvin & Donal P Keane

runners.name: Western Doyen
runners.spotlight: Has run only once since second at Killarney in August 2022; yard has traditionally done well with veterans; nonetheless, likely to need this.
runners.comment: Has run only once since second at Killarney in August 2022, yard does well with veterans

runners.name: All In Peder
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back winner in staying handicaps at Gowran and Listowel for Emmet Mullins in May/June 2023; has run infrequently in recent years; has struggled in three runs for this yard.
runners.comment: Has struggled in three runs for this yard, best form was on Flat for Emmet Mullins in 2023

runners.name: Moulane West
runners.spotlight: Only one win from 36 starts over hurdles, no encouragement from recent form; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, only one win from 36 starts over hurdles, no encouragement from recent form

races.race_name: Burleigh Accountancy Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Killowen House
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner; getting the hang of things over hurdles; fine effort in a Galway maiden on latest (2m6f, good); mark may be workable and interesting up in trip on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Fine maiden effort at Galway latest, mark may be workable on handicap debut, interesting

runners.name: Ladiam
runners.spotlight: Not the easiest to win with, as her 2-30 record over hurdles illustrates; both wins at Sligo over 20.5f, but did run a cracker in this last year when beaten 4.25l into second and she's 5lb lower now; yard in form and she shaped well at Wexford on latest; big chance.
runners.comment: Runner up in this last year, 5lb lower now, shaped well at Wexford latest, big chance

runners.name: Down Around
runners.spotlight: 1-21 over hurdles, the win coming at Thurles (2m4f, good) in November 2024 for Philip Rothwell; midfield at Kilbeggan on first run for this yard after a 232-day break so should be sharper now; now rated 2lb below his win and has run well here before; this trip is an unknown, however.
runners.comment: 2lb below sole win, has gone well here before, sharper for latest, trip an unknown

runners.name: Run For The Border
runners.spotlight: Won a Limerick maiden hurdle in October (2m3f, gd-yld); best run since a 2.25l second of 15 here over 2m6f (good) on penultimate off 3lb lower; not as good at Sligo four days ago and has stamina to prove for this trip.
runners.comment: Good 2m6f second here on penultimate, didn't back that up at Sligo, stamina to prove

runners.name: Dorans Law
runners.spotlight: Won this race in 2024 off this rating and fourth off 5lb higher last year; hinted that he may be returning to form in a handicap chase at Wexford on latest; could go well.
runners.comment: Won this in 2024 off this mark, hinted at return to form on latest, could go well

runners.name: Lord Ffrench
runners.spotlight: Has lost way since winning a 2m5f maiden hurdle at Sligo in August last year; weakened on both previous starts at 2m6f so stamina has to be a worry over this far; tongue-tie added to cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Lost way since Sligo maiden hurdle win, stamina a query at this trip, new headgear combo

runners.name: My Trump Card
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner on heavy for former yard; inauspicious start for this stable when 100-1 and tailed off at Galway (16.5f, good); needs softer ground.
runners.comment: Inauspicious start for this stable when 100-1 and tailed off at Galway, needs rain

runners.name: Strange Currency
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in a couple of runs for Gearoid O'Loughlin but arguably best form has come on rain- softened ground; unproven over this far and probably best watched on first run for new trainer.
runners.comment: Majority of best form on easy ground, unproven over this far, watch on stable debut

races.race_name: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Western Shores
runners.spotlight: Rated 98 after three runs over timber; her first two efforts at Tramore (2m, good) and Downpatrick (2m3f, good) saw her run to RPRs in the mid-90s; weakened over 20.5f at Bellewstown on latest, but bred to stay and Jack Kennedy takes over with a tongue-tie also added; chance.
runners.comment: Rated 98, below best latest but chance on first two runs, Kennedy takes over; tongue tied

runners.name: Keep Em Quite
runners.spotlight: Far from disgraced on handicap debut at Wexford when last seen in May, beaten 8l off a mark of 102; a repeat of that back would give him every chance in this race.
runners.comment: Good effort off 102 on handicap debut latest, a repeat of that would give him every chance

runners.name: Gainsville
runners.spotlight: 0-6 in point-to-points but did go close in a couple of them; not beaten all that far in Downpatrick maiden hurdle on latest (2m6f, good) and that's amongst the best form on offer in this race; player.
runners.comment: Not beaten all that far in Downpatrick maiden latest, player on that form
runners.owner: Both Sides Of The Water Syndicate

runners.name: Walkingmayotomilan
runners.spotlight: Placed in a couple of points; struggled on rules debut at Naas in January (18.5f, heavy), but much better effort when mid-field at Galway (RPR 90) after a six-month break; could run into the money here if the new tongue-tie ekes out more.
runners.comment: Decent run after six-month break at Galway, could go well if tongue tie works

runners.name: Three County Star
runners.spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles and rated just 76; pulled up in a handicap chase at Killarney last month; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: 0-11 over hurdles and rated 76, pulled up in chase on latest, others make more appeal
runners.owner: John P Coleman & M J Caffrey

runners.name: Likeyouhaveplenty
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and no show in bumper and two maiden hurdles; may need more time.
runners.comment: No show at massive odds in a bumper and two maiden hurdles, may need more time

runners.name: Hey Sir
runners.spotlight: Very modest form in point-to-points and under rules; beaten 19l off 82 in Wexford handicap chase on penultimate; was 22l behind when sixth in a Sligo maiden hurdle latest; cheekpieces worn that day left off now.
runners.comment: Very modest form so far, beaten 22l in Sligo maiden hurdle latest, cheekpieces discarded

runners.name: Scotty Joe
runners.spotlight: Point winner; stayed on well enough when sixth of 16 in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle (18.5f, good) in May; never sighted dropped back to 2m at Punchestown on latest; could do better now stepped up in distance.
runners.comment: Stayed on well over 18.5f at Kilbeggan, 2m too sharp latest, step up in trip a plus

runners.name: Barton Sky
runners.spotlight: Point winner made no impression on debut for this yard after a long absence in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last month; others preferred.
runners.comment: No impact on debut for this yard after long absence in a Kilbeggan maiden last month

runners.name: Derby Rock
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles and rated just 82; beaten 49l off that mark in a handicap chase at Wexford on latest; difficult to make a case.
runners.comment: 0-7 over hurdles, heavy handicap chase defeat off 82 latest, hard to make a case

runners.name: Rumi Rock
runners.spotlight: Failed to win a point and mid-field in both maiden hurdles, here and on latest at Galway when beaten 34l; given an RPR of 90 for that run, so place chance if he can build on it.
runners.comment: Midfield in both maiden hurdles, RPR of 90 on latest, place chance if builds on that

runners.name: Secret Moon
runners.spotlight: Difficult to make a case for based on the evidence of heavy maiden hurdle defeats at Downpatrick and Limerick.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats in both maiden hurdle starts, difficult to make a case for on form

runners.name: Room For One More
runners.spotlight: Beaten a cumulative distance of 89l in a Leopardstown bumper and when 22-1 in a Downpatrick mares' maiden hurdle; with a top yard but her claims are not obvious; any market support could be significant.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats in a bumper and Downpatrick maiden hurdle, top yard so check market

runners.name: Go To The Moon
runners.spotlight: First reserve; bought for 40,000GBP after winning a point in 2025; however, has struggled badly in a Sligo bumper and a Roscommon maiden hurdle, beaten 78l in the latter race; questions to answer now.
runners.comment: Point winner, poor form in both starts under Rules, questions to answer; reserve
runners.owner: A Cahill, M Dowd, P Glancy Partnership

runners.name: Boomerang Breeze
runners.spotlight: Very modest efforts in maiden hurdles at Limerick and Cork; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Modest efforts in first two maiden hurdles at Limerick and Cork, hard to fancy

runners.name: Kilmond Knight
runners.spotlight: 0-3 over hurdles and has had jumping issues; got around at Roscommon last time but was beaten 34l; needs more.
runners.comment: 0-3 over hurdles, has made jumping errors, beaten 34l on latest, more needed

races.race_name: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Moonshine Girl
runners.spotlight: Maiden has been knocking on the door in recent starts; beaten 1l at Limerick (2m6f, soft) and a neck on latest at Roscommon (3m, good); nudged up 3lb, but this could be her day.
runners.comment: Maiden knocking on the door, beaten a neck latest, up 3lb, this could be her day

runners.name: La Tene
runners.spotlight: Promise on soft when a 7l third at Clonmel (2m3f) back in March; similar effort over this C&D (good) 20 days ago; place chance but needs to find a bit more to win.
runners.comment: Decent third here on latest, place chance but needs to find a bit more to win
runners.owner: John Patrick Ryan & Miss Gillian Ryan

runners.name: Queen Kulina
runners.spotlight: Maiden is in decent form; beaten just 5l when third at Kilbeggan on penultimate; weakened late into fourth at Roscommon (3m, good) on latest; worth another go at this trip on that evidence; place chance.
runners.comment: In decent form, worth another go at this trip on evidence of last run, place shout

runners.name: It's Time Again
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner (including over C&D); in the lead when overjumping and falling two out on her penultimate start at Clonmel; below-par here on latest but is on last winning mark and loves this place; not discounted.
runners.comment: C&D winner, three wins here in total, runs off last winning mark, not discounted

runners.name: Joshua Chamberlain
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; struggled on return from huge layoff at Punchestown in May, but proved some ability remained with a nice fourth over C&D last month; 2lb below sole win and could be a player.
runners.comment: Latest fourth here proved ability remained, player if getting a run; reserve
runners.owner: J R Robinson & Mrs E Keane

runners.name: Nothing Hectic
runners.spotlight: C&D (good) maiden hurdle winner last August; form has nosedived since and beaten around 20l in handicaps in both starts this year; return to this venue needs to spark.
runners.comment: C&D maiden hurdle winner, soundly beaten both starts this year, needs to revive

runners.name: Mini Getaway
runners.spotlight: Point winner is 0-9 over hurdles and her latest third in a handicap chase at Downpatrick in May was a very remote one; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Point winner, 0-9 over hurdles, beaten 28l when third in chase latest, others preferred

runners.name: Cornaroya Rocco
runners.spotlight: Showed ability in maidens and again when a 1.25l second over 20.5f (good) in a Killarney handicap hurdle on latest; should go well again off 3lb higher, but must prove stamina for this longer trip.
runners.comment: Good second on latest, nudged up 3lb, must prove stamina for this longer trip

runners.name: Tawny Lea
runners.spotlight: Not much promise in maidens and tailed off at 66-1 on handicap debut at Kilbeggan (2m3f, good); not easy to fancy.
runners.comment: Modest maiden form, tailed off at 66-1 on h'cap debut, not easy to fancy

runners.name: Lost Features
runners.spotlight: First reserve; best run yet in handicaps over C&D (good) on latest, staying on from the back for a 7.25l fifth of 15; could run on late into the places.
runners.comment: Stayed on well over C&D latest, could run into the places if getting a run; reserve
runners.owner: Profit In Your Pocket Racing Club

runners.name: Tannery Park
runners.spotlight: Bolted up over C&D (good) off 6lb lower when last sighted in May 2025; non-runner twice last month on account of good ground, so might need a drop of rain.
runners.comment: Bolted up over C&D when last seen, non-runner twice last month on account of good ground

runners.name: Pilgrims Walk
runners.spotlight: Ran a fine race on handicap debut at Kilbeggan (24.5f, good), staying on well and finding just one too good; raised 4lb for that and cheekpieces go on; whether this sharper trip will suit is debateable, but can't be discounted.
runners.comment: Up 4lb for fine run on h'cap bow, cheekpieces on, shorter trip a query but can't discount

runners.name: Ranger Billy
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won since October 2024; bounced back from non-completions on first two runs for this yard with an encouraging third over C&D (good) last month; should be in the mix with a repeat of that.
runners.comment: Back to form over C&D latest, should be in the mix with a repeat of that

runners.name: Poetic Focus
runners.spotlight: 0-12 and hasn't looked like shedding the maiden tag in recent starts; tailed off at Sligo latest; others more convincing.
runners.comment: 0-12, tailed off on latest at Sligo, others more convincing

runners.name: Everystep Oftheway
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; in okay form when last seen in July 2024; on a workable mark on best form, but entitled to need this after such a long layoff.
runners.comment: Off since July 2024, on decent mark but may need this after long layoff; reserve

runners.name: Political Stance
runners.spotlight: Beaten 20l on handicap debut at Clonmel in February (16.5f, heavy) and was never travelling when pulled up over 20.5f at Down Royal when last seen in March; eased 2lb but best watched unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: Pulled up when last seen at Down Royal in March, watch unless market speaks

runners.name: Chanceitlucky
runners.spotlight: Best maiden run came over 2m4f at Punchestown on nice ground; no impact over 2m on handicap bow on heavy at Navan when last seen in November; worth a market check moving up in trip on better ground.
runners.comment: Promise in 2m4f maiden, struggled on heavy when last seen at Navan, check the market

runners.name: Urbs Intacta Manet
runners.spotlight: Showed little in maidens and similar story in first two handicaps; hard to fancy on form.
runners.comment: No show in maidens, similar story in first two handicaps, hard to fancy on form

runners.name: The Little Yank
runners.spotlight: Course winner took a step back in the right direction at Kilbeggan on latest after four non-completions in a row; third of four, only beaten 5l, in Kilbeggan chase on Saturday.
runners.comment: Course winner has come back to a bit of form in last two outings at Kilbeggan
